message.content:
I don’t have access to live traffic feeds, so I can’t give you a real‑time snapshot of congestion in New York City right now.  

If you need up‑to‑date traffic information, the best options are:

| Service | How to use it |
|---------|---------------|
| **Google Maps** | Open the app or website, type “New York” or your specific destination, and tap the “Traffic” layer. |
| **Waze** | The app shows live traffic, road closures, and incidents. |
| **City of New York DOT** | Their website and mobile app provide traffic camera feeds and incident reports. |
| **NYC Open Data** | The NYC Open Data portal offers datasets on traffic volume, congestion, and incident reports that can be queried if you’re comfortable with data analysis. |

If you’re looking for a general sense of typical traffic patterns, let me know and I can give you an overview of peak hours, major bottlenecks, and common detours.
